features.name: Shadow Arts
features.desc: You learn the Minor Illusion cantrip. By spending 1 Focus Point, you can use an action to create Darkness for 10 minutes and see through it. You also master Shadow Step.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, as a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 60 feet to another area of Dim Light or Darkness; your next melee attack before the end of the turn has Advantage.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.desc: As an action in Dim Light or Darkness, you become Invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or enter Bright Light.

features.name: Imperceptible Form
features.desc: As an action, by spending 3 Focus Points, you become undetectable by creatures and devices for 1 minute; attacks against you have Disadvantage, and your attacks against marked targets have Advantage.
